caption: The drawing features five distinct, stylized floral designs arranged loosely across a light beige background. The flowers and foliage are rendered in solid blocks of color, including shades of red, pink, yellow, green, and dark green. At the top left, there is a rounded flower with symmetrical petals in red, pink, yellow, and pale green, and spiked leaves radiating outward. To the right, another floral composition consists of curving, scalloped shapes in dark red and pink with pale green leaves and thin, wavy stems. Below, in the center left, there is a small cluster of two stylized daisy-like blooms and leaves in hues of red, yellow, and pink. At the lower left, a curved, fan-shaped flower is depicted in yellow, red, pink, and purple with a mix of rounded and pointed petals. At the lower right, a branching motif displays a mix of heart-shaped and scalloped petals in red, pink, yellow, and violet. The drawing appears symmetrical in balance, with the floral elements distributed evenly across the background, and each design is outlined and separated from the others with negative space.
title: Detail of Bedspread Pattern
